P.name: Silver Stake
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Locke's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{pplevel|5 to 40|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, increased by {{pp|key=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100|0 to 70 by 5|key1=%|formula=7.14% for every 5% target's missing health, with the maximum at 70% target's missing health|color=health}}, up to {{pplevel|5*2 to 40*2|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}.

Q.name: Ritual Nails
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Locke''' hurls a nail in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|slows}} them by 25% for 1 second, and applies a {{tip|stack}} of ''Soul Nails'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. Against targets with at least 2 stacks, the {{tip|slow}} is increased to 60% and lasts for 2 seconds.

''Ritual Nails'' can be recast twice more within 4 seconds of the activation at no additional cost, with a {{fd|0.5}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage per Nail|{{ap|40 to 72}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}
|Maximum Nail Damage|{{ap|40*3 to 72*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*3}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Locke''' mimics the first cast's effects. For each recast not used when ''Ritual Nails'' ends, {{pp|20 to 35|key=%}} of the ability's {{sti|cooldown}} and {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost is refunded, up to a {{pp|20*2 to 35*2|key=%}} refund for two remaining recasts.
Q.description3: '''Locke's''' next damaging {{tip|basic attack}} or ''{{ai|Ashen Pursuit|Locke}}'' against an enemy with ''Soul Nails'' stacks consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the amount of stacks.

W.name: Soul Ignition
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Locke''' ignites his soul for 6 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{as|{{pplevel|40 to 70|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}} and {{as|40% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} '''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}, with the latter decaying to {{as|20%|ms}} over 1 second after {{fd|1.5}} seconds have elapsed.
W.description2: Additionally, during the effect he stores an amount of [[grey health]] on his [[health bar]] equal to 100% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes from enemy {{tip|champions}}, up to a cap, plus the total amount of health expended from ''Soul Ignition's'' {{tip|health resource|health cost}}. '''Locke''' additionally stores up to {{pplevel|40 to 200}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} grey health for himself, based on {{as|his '''missing''' health}} and ''Soul Ignition's'' elapsed duration. The {{as|'''missing''' health}} portion of this additional grey health stored reaches its maximum when his {{as|'''current''' health}} is at or below {{pplevel|150 to 450|color=health}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Damage taken grey health cap|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
W.description3: After {{fd|0.5}} seconds, ''Soul Ignition'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
W.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Locke''' ends ''Soul Ignition'' and consumes his [[grey health]] to {{tip|heal}} for the same amount.
W.description5: ''Soul Ignition's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''

E.name: Ashen Pursuit
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Locke''' {{tip|blinks}} to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies upon arrival.
E.description2: After a {{fd|0.1}}-second delay, he empowers his next {{tip|basic attack|icononly=true}} {{tt|attack command|Technically not a basic attack, see notes. This dash ability is performed as soon as his declared attack target is within attack range (normally 400 units).}} within 4 seconds to gain {{sti|range|275 '''bonus''' range}} and cause him to {{tip|dash}} in the target's direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies along the way, and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects to the primary target hit.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Dash Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|40+40 to 80+120}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40+40}}% AP)}}}}
E.description3: Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} resets the {{sti|cooldown}}.
E.description4: '''''Locke''' {{tt|cannot perform|See notes}} the dash while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}.''

R.name: Purgatory
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Locke''' throws a totem artifact that travels to the target location over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. After landing for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, the totem fires latching nails at nearby enemies: dealing {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 99% decaying over 2 seconds, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 1 second, and marking enemy {{tip|champions}} hit for 5 seconds. Marked enemies are {{tip|execute|executed}} below a portion of their {{as|health}}. Successful executions refresh the mark duration on all affected targets.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 300}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Execute Threshold|{{as|{{ap|10 to 12}}%|hp}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}}% per Sealed Champion stack)|buzzword}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
R.description2: Once all marks expire, and if at least one {{tip|champion}} was executed, the totem seals the souls of all executed champions and drops to the ground both over {{fd|2.25}} seconds. It then lingers for a duration equal to ''Purgatory's'' {{tt|{{sti|'''remaining''' cooldown}}|Remaining CD at the time that the totem initialized the sealing process.}}, but for no less than 10 seconds. '''Locke''' can move near the totem to collect it, and for each soul sealed it will both reduce ''Purgatory's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by 20% of its '''total''' cooldown and grant him a permanent {{as|Sealed Champion|buzzword}} stack.
